label.description: The suggestion's words, a short action in sentence case, such as Wire up the invite email: at most 60 characters, saying what it sets off.

prompt.description: The brief the new agent is handed as its first message: everything it needs to start on its work, since it knows nothing else of yours.

title.description: The new agent's title; leave it out to have it named.

branch.description: The branch of the task's repository to clone its checkout at, which must be on GitHub when the button is pressed; leave it out for the default branch.

model.description: The model to run on, by its catalog id, as list_models lists it; leave it out with the effort for the default of the member who sends it.

effort.description: The reasoning effort, as the model lists it; given with the model or not at all.

start.description: Suggest a new agent on the task you work on, started as the member who sends it, where their agents on the task run.

agentId.description: Another agent of your workspace, by the id list_agents answered.

text.description: The words sent to it, as the member who sends them.

send.description: Suggest words for an agent that is already running, sent as the member who sends them.
